thesisQuality.note: Record sales plus 33%-103% electrical backlog growth support durable demand and value capture, but exact data-center backlog mix is undisclosed.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: 21% sales growth, 14% organic growth and 22%-23% FCF/OCF growth are strong, tempered by 80 bps year-over-year segment-margin contraction.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: ~43x trailing and ~28x forward P/E with ~$169B market cap is demanding relative to the calibration's downside-adjusted headroom test despite strong growth.

catalystScore.note: Raised 2026 organic-growth guidance and the announced Mobility separation provide identifiable operating/portfolio catalysts, though execution timing remains material.

governancePower.note: Management raised guidance after record results and is actively focusing the portfolio via Mobility separation; reviewed evidence supports disciplined execution but is insufficient for an exceptional stewardship score.

alignment2036.note: Electrical distribution, protection and power-management capability is directly exposed to durable electrification, data-center and infrastructure load growth across end markets.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Electrical Americas, Electrical Global and Aerospace provide multiple demand engines; issuer states data centers are key while robust demand spans end markets.

bottleneckControl.note: Large electrical backlog/order growth supports participation in constrained power-infrastructure capacity, but evidence does not establish Eaton as an irreplaceable sole bottleneck.

scenarioRobustness.note: Demand is distributed across electrical and aerospace markets and is not solely dependent on AI/data centers, improving robustness across plausible infrastructure scenarios.

substitutionResilience.note: Broad power-management portfolio and installed-channel exposure support replacement friction, while vendor/product substitution remains plausible and prevents an exceptional score.

supplyChainResilience.note: Strong realized growth demonstrates current execution capacity, but reviewed evidence does not establish exceptional multi-source redundancy; unknown supply concentration is treated conservatively.

pricingPower.note: Strong orders/backlog and 23.1% segment margin support commercial strength, but year-over-year margin contraction argues against assuming unrestricted price pass-through.

risk.note: Principal risks are demanding valuation, 80 bps segment-margin contraction, acquisition/portfolio integration and normalization of elevated electrical demand/backlog.

confidence.note: Core operating claims are primary-source addressed and current valuation is independently sourced; confidence is reduced for undisclosed data-center backlog mix, supply concentration and limited proxy-specific governance evidence.

thesis: Eaton is a high-quality power-management beneficiary of multi-year electrification and data-center infrastructure demand, with unusually strong order/backlog visibility and cash generation, offset by a demanding valuation and execution/mix risk.
keyRisk: The market price already discounts substantial durable growth while segment margins have contracted year over year, leaving downside if backlog growth or integration economics normalize.
nextCatalyst: Conversion of elevated electrical backlog into sales/cash flow and execution of the announced Mobility separation, with the next earnings update expected in early November 2026.
